_about: Pairs of real listings from the catalogue as sampled on 2026-09-25, labelled by hand. identity: the same product in the same package. substitute: a different product a shopper looking for the other would accept without surprise -- same kind, same variant (flavour, fat, organic, lactose free), same pack format, a similar size. different: anything else. Where it was unclear, the label says so in a note. Sources: neighbour = the most similar same-size listing at another store by trigram similarity, which the matcher had no part in choosing; proposal = pairs the matcher proposed over the whole catalogue; hard case = near misses picked from the staples listing. ambiguous_identity marks a pair whose identity key another SKU at the same store also held in the catalogue, which the matcher never treats as an identity.
